BiblicalUsage: Meshillemoth = "recompense"; 1) an Ephraimite, one of the chiefs of the tribe in the reign of king Pekah of Israel; 1a) also 'Meshillemith'; 2) a priest, son of Immer; 2a) also 'Meshillemith'
